main_text.p: الرواجب i.e. flexurarum eorundem, seu juxta alios, unguium extremorum ; quatuor reliqui ad reliquas corporis partes, eo, quo dictum est, modo. Harum rerum cum incuriosiores factos Arabes videret Mohammedes, ritus (ut videtur) antiquitus receptos, ipse lege nova sanxit ac omnibus necessarios observatu fecit.

l.24.Oratio ] Inter dicta Mohammedis, quibus orationem suis commendatam voluit, haec feruntur: الصلوة عماد الدين فمن تركها فقد هدم الدين Oratio religionis columna est, quâ sublatâ ruit religio, & مفتاح الجنة الصلوة Clavis Paradisi oratio. Liceat autem hic quae in libro Moftatraf leguntur de Orationis apud Arabes nomine & Etymo adscribere, اختلف في اشتقاق اسم الصلوة &c. Diversa sunt sententia de Etymo nominis الصلوة, cur eo scil. appelle-tur oratio. Dici volunt nonnulli eâ notione quâ idem valet ac الدعا Invocatio, alii eâ quâ misericordiam denotat, ut cûm dicunt صلى الله عليه, quod significat, {*} Propitius fit ei Deus,non ut à nonnullis versum est, Oret pro eo Deus: alii à significatione امتقامة Rectificationis; ut cum dicunt صلوت العون Lignum rectum feci, quia oratio recte dirigat hominem in cultu Dei, & ab inobedientia cohibeat; alii denique لا لها صلة Quod mutua sit relatio seu necessitudo quaedâ inter servum i.e.Hominê & Dominû suum.Seu ut Ebnol Athir, Honoret eum Deus, à r quâ significatione & dictam orationê vult, quod eo cultu honoretur Deus,

page.notes: Arabic readings in the running text are copied from the scan and are not fully certain; the Arabic words الصلوة, عماد الدين and مفتاح الجنة are the most legible. The first Arabic line (الرواجب) is a fragment whose full form is not visible on this part. The marginal reference "l.24." is treated as a note at the start of the paragraph beginning "Oratio". The Arabic fragments (امتقامة, صلوت العون, لا لها صلة) are read with doubt and should be checked against the scan. The margin note's "significatione" is a mixed-script letter in my reading and is probably "significatione"; the note text "à r quâ" appears to be printed as shown. The page number and running head are not visible on this part of the page.
